faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Simon Fraser University Area?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 5 houses and 91 condos and townhomes listed in Simon Fraser University Area. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Simon Fraser University Area a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 7% (a buyers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Simon Fraser University Area from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 1 houses and 30 condos and townhomes sold in Simon Fraser University Area over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in August with 1 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 9 sold.

faq.q: How big is Simon Fraser University Area compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In September 2026, Simon Fraser University Area held 1.1% of the 458 detached houses listed in Burnaby and 6.8% of the 1,333 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Simon Fraser University Area?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 5.2% of the 96 homes listed in Simon Fraser University Area and condos and townhomes made up 94.8%; of the 6 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Simon Fraser University Area than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 8 to 5 (−37.5%) and condos and townhomes fell from 94 to 91 (−3.2%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
